newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwangju Bank to set US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Kwangju Bank to set US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: Kwangju Bank has mandated KDB Asia to arrange its first floating rate note issue, bankers said on Thursday.
They said the US$50 million FRN had a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue would be priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees had not been decided yet.
An arranger group of four to five banks was being sought.
General syndication would start in early or mid-September.
